text:
alex: quick heads-up: users reported seeing dashboard rows from another org momentarily after rapid workspace switches. Repro with steps below. :grimacing:

jess: can you paste the failing request/response?

alex: example snippet from quickpreview logs:
```
[quickprefetch] t=2026-03-21T09:12:03Z sess=sess-9a1 org=org-alpha key=qp::q=alerts -> cached.items: [{id:111, org:org-alpha}, {id:222, org:org-beta}]
```

maria: ohhh the cache returned mixed-org items. Where are we setting the cache key?

alex: currently key = session_id + query_hash; we intentionally omitted org to improve hit rate. This edge-case happens when people share session cookies across tabs and switch orgs quickly.

ryan: severity: low customer impact so far, but this breaks quota attribution and rollout experiments (we might think org-beta saw feature X). Also telemetry labels get polluted.

jess: two options: 1) add org to cache key (cheap), 2) keep key but validate cached payload's item.orgs against request.org and evict if mismatch (safer). Thoughts?

maria: we should do both: short-term validate on return + metric; medium-term change key to include org/workspace. Validating lets us keep existing cache performance for common cases but avoids bad responses.

sam-billing: ping billing—if this leaks attribution we might bill wrong orgs for API usage. Need a telemetry hook to detect misattribution and a reconciliation job.

jess: agreed. Proposed immediate patch:
- server-side guard: if cached and any(item.org != req.org for item in cached.items): record `quickprefetch.cache.mismatch` + evict + fetch live
- set cache key to include org in next deploy
- add unit test simulating concurrent org-swap in same session
- add dashboard + alert for mismatch > 5 / 1h

alex: sample guard pseudo-code:
```
key = f"qp:{session_id}:{query_hash}"
cached = cache.get(key)
if cached:
  if any(it["org"] != req.org for it in cached["items"]):
    metrics.incr("quickprefetch.cache.mismatch")
    cache.delete(key)
    resp = fetch_live()
  else:
    resp = cached
else:
  resp = fetch_live()
```

ryan: perf note: validation will add CPU but only iterates over returned items (usually < 20). OK for hotfix. Changing key to include org will reduce cross-org hits but seems necessary for correctness.

maria: also let's instrument `prefetch.returned_orgs` as a label so we can inspect multi-org responses historically. Keep values limited (truncate to first 5) to avoid cardinality explosion.

sam-billing: billing team: can we get a cheap reconciliation script that consumes `quickprefetch.cache.mismatch` traces and reassigns token/row counts if needed? We'll need a mapping from trace_id -> request ids -> orgs.

jess: rollout plan: hotfix -> canary 5% (30m) -> monitor mismatch metric + quickpreview errors -> 50% -> if stable 100%. Hold before 50% until billing confirms no outstanding misbilling.

alex: I'll open the PR for the guard + tests and tag @maria for telemetry changes.

maria: I'll add the Grafana panel and a logging pipeline filter to capture `prefetch.returned_orgs` and `trace_id`.

ryan: created a short QA script to reproduce with two headless browsers switching org header rapidly; will run against staging after merge.

jess: long-term debate: should scoping guards live at the prefetcher, the gateway/router, or both? I'd prefer defensive checks in prefetcher + router-level assertions so we never return cross-org payloads from any internal cache. Router-level may be more central for other services.

maria: +1. Router-level enforcement can be a break-glass if services misbehave; but putting guard at prefetcher avoids extra hop/gateway latency. We'll add both: prefetcher guard now, router invariant later.

sam-billing: please add a one-time job that scans historical `returned_orgs` logs for the last 7 days and flags potential misbilling windows. We can follow up on customers if needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary 5% at 1777778500 by @ryan. :rocket:

jess: small housekeeping: update the rollout playbook to include the billing sync step and an emergency rollback trigger if mismatch spikes > 50 in 15m.

alex: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1987 (mock). Assign reviewers: @jess, @maria, @ryan.

maria: dashboard link (staging): https://graf.redwood/d/xyz/quickprefetch (mock)  alert added.

ryan: target: merge in 45m, run staging QA for 30m, canary at scheduled time.

jess: thanks all. Good catch  not sexy but important. :+1:
